subject: Tenant bridge & connectivity: preflight questions and checklist request
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@cyanlabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cyanlabs.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant bridge & connectivity preflight — diagram attached

Hi Ben / Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week. We're starting to assemble the network and security preflight for our Private deployment (VPC with a customer-hosted bridge) and I wanted to send over a first-pass diagram and list of clarifying questions so we can align on the onboarding checklist items. Attachment: cyan_vpc_sketch.pdf (2 pages, network sketch)

Top-line questions we need help with:
- BGP vs static routing: does Redwood require eBGP for the tenant bridge or do you support static routes for the initial handoff? If eBGP, what ASN ranges do you expect from our side?
- CIDR requirements: are there reserved CIDR blocks Redwood will use inside the enclave we should avoid? If there are recommendations for pod/service subnets, share them.
- Egress & outbound IPs: we need the list of egress IPs (or ranges) and any requirements for NAT gateways / public egress.
- Firewall & ports: provide a minimal port allowlist for the control plane and runtime (including health checks, KV cache replication, telemetry).
- KMS / keying: we use AWS KMS; do you require an HSM-backed key or is KMS (customer-managed) sufficient? Also confirm required IAM roles and trust policy for the service account.
- Test plan: suggested smoke tests we should run during the activation window (sample inference workload, KV cache warm, latency probes).

Procurement has asked for a SoW draft for budget planning — I'll attach that separately. We can be flexible on the activation window but prefer week of Jul 12 if possible.

Can you send the Redwood internal preflight checklist you normally use for tenant-bridge onboarding? That will help us mark owners and timelines.

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Infrastructure Lead, Cyan Labs
attachments: cyan_vpc_sketch.pdf (diagram)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@cyanlabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bridge & connectivity preflight — diagram attached

Hi Samantha — great to see the sketch, thanks for sending.

Short answers up front and next steps:
- eBGP recommended but static routing supported for initial handoff; we'll provide both config templates. If you go eBGP, prefer ASN in the private range (64512–65534) or a documented public ASN — we'll accept either.
- Reserved CIDR: please avoid 10.128.0.0/10 — our internal staging ranges use parts of that space. We'll send a recommended CIDR matrix in the checklist.
- Egress: we'll provide a short list of IP ranges used by our control plane and optional public egress pools. If you require fixed egress IPs, we can allocate a static NAT pool (see checklist item).
- Ports: minimal allowlist below (control plane + runtime): TCP 443 (control plane), TCP 2200 (agent tunnel), TCP 7070 (metrics), UDP 4789 (overlay), ICMP for health probes. Full table in the checklist.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS ok; HSM not required for initial rollout unless your compliance team requires it. Provide an IAM role with AssumeRole policy pointing to our service account — I'll get Karthik to add the exact trust document.
- Smoke tests: sample inference (1k tokens/min for 5 mins), KV warm (replay of last 1k requests), and a latency tail check (p99 under 200ms).

I attached our Redwood onboarding checklist (redwood_private_onboard_checklist_v1.pdf) — it's the short form we use to gate environments. Can you review and mark owners?

Proposed 30-minute call: Mon Jun 22 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue Jun 23 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works for you?

I'll loop Karthik for the route/IAM specifics and Marissa for ops runbook and cutover coordination.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_private_onboard_checklist_v1.pdf
